sentences.en: Hiromi decided to risk bungee-jumping, even though he was scared.
sentences.zh: hiroymi决定冒险尝试蹦极，尽管他很害怕。

sentences.en: She became scared when she noticed the man following her.
sentences.zh: 她注意到有个男人在跟踪她后变得害怕起来。

sentences.en: It scares me that we have frequently had earthquakes lately.
sentences.zh: 最近地震频繁发生让我感到害怕。
